description: First Solar, Inc. is a global provider of photovoltaic (PV) solar energy solutions, operating in numerous international markets including the United States, Japan, France, Canada, India, and Australia. The company's primary activity involves the engineering, manufacturing, and…
mda_take: FY2025 net sales rose 24% to $5,219.4M on 24% higher module volume, but gross margin fell 3.6pp to 40.6% on a higher U.S.-produced mix, warehousing/logistics costs and tariffs (+$94.4M to COGS), partly offset by higher Section 45X credits ($1.6B recognized; $1,401.6M of credits sold for $1,336.3M cash). First Solar produced 16.1 GW / sold 17.5 GW; year-end contracted backlog fell to 50.1 GW ($15.0B through 2030) from 68.5 GW a year earlier, and the BP Solar/Lightsource master-supply termination triggered $384.6M of provisions. Cash/marketable securities ended at $2.9B (up from $1.8B) — strong volume-and-cash growth against margin compression, backlog erosion and heavy policy (45X/OBBBA/Section 232) dependence.
transcript_take: Q1 2026 was a beat: diluted EPS $3.22 (net income $347M, +65% YoY) on record Q1 net sales of $1.0B (+24%), gross margin 47% (+6pp YoY) and adjusted EBITDA $520M above the prior $400-500M preview, with FY2026 guidance reaffirmed and Q2 guided to 3.4-4.0 GW / $400-500M EBITDA. But management stays deliberately 'highly selective' on incremental U.S. bookings pending the Section 232 polysilicon-derivatives decision (expected Q2 2026) and FEOC rulemaking, an ITC Section 337 TOPCon-infringement investigation was instituted, and ex-45X gross margin is only ~7% — real positives (record quarter, margin expansion, reaffirmed guide) against genuine policy/booking overhangs.
